s.note: So-crates, a snack from ancient Greece
s.how: Cube 200g feta and mix with 200g mixed olives, 80ml olive oil, the zest of 1 lemon, 1 tsp dried oregano and a pinch of chilli flakes. Leave 30 minutes at room temperature and serve with 1 sliced crusty loaf.

s.note: England, way back, with the princesses
s.how: Dissolve 80g salt and 80g brown sugar in 2L water and brine 4 turkey drumsticks overnight. Pat dry and roast at 160C for 90 minutes. Brush with 3 tbsp honey mixed with 2 tbsp wholegrain mustard for the last 15 minutes.

m.how: Brown 1kg chicken thigh fillets in 2 tbsp olive oil and set aside. Soften 1 diced onion and 3 crushed garlic cloves, add 200g sliced mushrooms, 125ml white wine and a 400g can diced tomatoes. Return the chicken, simmer covered for 30 minutes, scatter with parsley and serve with crusty bread.

w.note: huge, everything on it, Napoleon's challenge
w.how: Line a long dish with 4 split bananas. Add scoops of vanilla, chocolate and strawberry ice cream down the middle. Pile on whipped cream, chocolate sauce, sprinkles, chopped nuts and cherries. Give everyone a long spoon.

d.note: the phone booth that travels through time
d.how: Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Pour 150ml chilled grape juice into each, top with 100ml soda water and squeeze in a wedge of lime. Stir once and serve with a lime wheel on the rim.
